items.title: 52193_Jay McShann oral history interview
items.q: he was telling me about how he and Basie used to do and so we would, you know, do the same thing

ctx.x: No, white fella. He owned about a third of Kansas City and then he was also -- owned a big portion of the Travelers Insurance, Hartford, Connecticut, you know? He was big -- and so, but he liked piano and so that's how he and Basie would get together and they'd go down to Jenkins and play two pianos, you know, and do duets together

and come out and he had a recording thing that he'd play something, record it, play it back, you know, like that. So, he had me to come out and he was telling me about how he and Basie used to do and so we would, you know, do the same thing, you know, and so he told me one night, says, "Look, they're having a thing over at the country club. You'd like to come over there and a certain part down there in the basement, they just have piano alone. So they got a couple of other bands up on the other floors. But if you…
Well, all I was doing, making during that time, let's see, I think about $2 a night or something like that, you know, because I had left the Monroe Inn--

items.title: Jay McShann interviewed by Monk Rowe, Sarasota, Florida, April 12, 1996
items.q: So we’d go down there and we’d have three pianos. And we’d just have a ball, the three of us.

ctx.x: You and the count were kind of compatriots in the same kind of music.

Yes, well see there was a white fellow there, he played piano too. Named Walter Bales in Kansas City. And Walter liked to play for himself. And he’d listen to me, and he’d get together and he’d rent a piano room and he’d rent it and he and Basie, they’d get together, and he’d rent the room for two pianos in it. And then after I came to Kansas City, he would get three pianos, because Basie would be coming through on a tour, he’d say, “Bill will be in town” so he says, “get ready, I’m going to rent three pianos in…
Bales, they were very good friends. They’d been friends, Basie used to come out to his house and play you know, play the piano you know.
